purpose: State that a resource or quality is necessary.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Experience is necessary for this job.
A reservation is required for entry.
I need a little more time.
restrictions: The noun names what is needed; 必要がある follows an action.
mistake: Use a nominalized form when naming an action as the necessary thing.
